title: Per-question preview image
summary: A server route /og/<date> renders a 1200×630 preview with the day's question, date tiles and a strip of the board's blue ? keys; every puzzle page sets absolute og:image, og:url and twitter:image to it, and the shared link becomes /hra/<date>. See og.png for the rendered image.
tradeoffs: Adds satori, @resvg/resvg-js (a native module with per-platform binaries) and @fontsource/bricolage-grotesque; the image uses the normal-width Bricolage because satori cannot use the variable width axis. Future dates return 404 so questions never leak early.
